name: MonkeyUp
summary: 🐒 Monkey Up is your cozy climb-to-the-top adventure! Play as a monkey and scale your way through colorful environments filled with secrets, chill zones, and places to mess around with friends. 🧗‍♀️ Whether you're racing to the top or just hanging out, there's always something new to find. No swinging—just pure climbing, exploring, and vibing. 🌿✨ With smooth movement, multiplayer fun, and a laid-back feel, Monkey Up is all about good times and monkey business. 🍌🎮
